key_insight: Bound-Aware Tree-IQO turns quantum-guided greedy reductions into reversible search that preserves the possibility of finding and certifying the optimum.
engineering_relevance: Quantum guidance can be integrated with classical branch-and-bound to prioritize search, improve feasible solutions, and prune branches without sacrificing exactness.
method: Use quantum-generated information to guide classical reductions and branching.
Update a shared incumbent from feasible measured samples and prune using valid classical bounds.
Backtrack to explore alternatives, returning the best feasible solution when interrupted or certifying optimality after complete search.
evidence_signal: MaxCut experiments through n=28 show nonrandom QAOA-guided ordering in exact-certification tests and demonstrate that quantum samples can improve incumbents and enable further pruning.
watch_item: Optimality certification may require superpolynomial classical time, and the reported experiments do not establish a quantum speedup.
paper_title: Iterative Quantum Optimization: From Greedy Reductions to Branch-and-Bound
